description: IS GDUEZ Atom-Feed - Informationssystem Karte der Erdbebenzonen in Nordrhein-Westfalen - Downloaddienst is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gis-rest.nrw.de. This download service provides the information system map of the earthquake zones in North Rhine-Westphalia. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "IS GDUEZ Atom-Feed - Information system Map of earthquake zones in North Rhine-Westphalia - Download service" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Seismische Aktivität, infoFeatureAccessService, Untergrundklasse, Erdbebenzone. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ATOM. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
